battle.name: 安哥拉內戰
battle.theater: 安哥拉中南部與南部邊境
battle.brief: 一九七五年一月《阿爾沃協議》之後，葡屬安哥拉三個解放運動爭奪獨立國的主導權，人民解放運動得蘇聯與古巴支持，全國解放陣線得美國與南非支持。這支一九七四年定裝的突擊步槍是人民解放武裝部隊與古巴革命軍的制式步槍，在羅安達攻防與南部叢林伏擊中提供近距火力，到二〇〇二年盧埃納備忘錄才停火。

kit.name: 卡拉什尼科夫突擊步槍
kit.history: AK-74是蘇軍摩托化步兵師步兵連的制式突擊步槍，配置於基層步兵班，負責近距離一般火力，是連隊地面進攻中的主要步兵武器。

countries: 安哥拉內戰自一九七五年一月《阿爾沃協議》簽訂後全面展開，交戰方主要分成以人民解放運動為核心的人民解放軍一方，與以全國解放陣線、民族解放陣線為核心的另一方，另有古巴、南非、薩伊爾等外國部隊直接介入。人民解放運動的核心武裝是人民解放武裝部隊，一九七五年由阿戈什蒂諾·內托以武裝部隊總司令身份統一領導，作戰上按軍區劃分防區，主要兵力部署在中部羅安達周邊各省與南部戰區；一九七九年內托病逝後由若澤·愛杜瓦多·多斯桑托斯接任總統兼武裝部隊總司令，軍隊體制沿用蘇聯顧問協助建立的編制，基層步兵連配發蘇制突擊步槍。反對派一方以全國解放陣線為主力，總司令若納斯·薩維比以萬博省的比耶高原為根據地，山區游擊隊與省級民兵合流；一九七五年自海外返回的民族解放陣線由霍爾登·羅伯托領導，根據地在薩伊爾境內，同年十一月二十三日與全國解放陣線合併成立以萬博為首都的聯合政府，羅伯托與薩維比出任共同總統。一九七六年民族解放陣線主力崩潰後，其骨幹併入全國解放陣線。外國方面，古巴革命武裝力量部以卡洛塔行動名義自一九七五年十月起派兵，南非國防軍以薩凡納行動等名義進入南部安哥拉，蘇聯派軍事顧問與東德派飛行員及顧問團，美國中央情報局以秘密計劃援助全國解放陣線，薩伊爾則以裝甲車、傘兵與步兵營支援民族解放陣線；法國支持的卡賓達解放陣線在北部沿海另建根據地。
countriesEn: The Angolan Civil War opened up in full after the Alvor Accords were signed in January 1975. The belligerents fell into two main camps: on one side, the Popular Movement for the Liberation of Angola (MPLA) with its armed wing, the People's Armed Forces of Liberation of Angola (FAPLA); on the other, the National Union for the Total Independence of Angola (UNITA) and the National Liberation Front of Angola (FNLA), with Cuban, South African and Zairean troops intervening directly. The core armed force of the MPLA was the People's Armed Forces of Liberation of Angola, unified in 1975 under the supreme command of Agostinho Neto, and organised for operations into military regions, with the bulk of the strength deployed in the central provinces around Luanda and in the southern theatre. After Neto's death from illness in 1979, José Eduardo dos Santos succeeded him as president and commander-in-chief; the force kept the organisation built with Soviet advice, with Soviet-pattern assault rifles issued down to the infantry section. On the other side the backbone was UNITA under commander-in-chief Jonas Savimbi, whose base was the Bie highlands around Huambo, where guerrilla bands and provincial militias had merged. The FNLA, led by Holden Roberto, had returned from overseas in 1975 with its base in Zaire; on 23 November of that year the FNLA and UNITA fused into a coalition government headquartered at Huambo, with Roberto and Savimbi as co-presidents. After the FNLA's main body collapsed in 1976, its cadre was absorbed into UNITA. Among the foreign participants, the Cuban Revolutionary Armed Forces deployed from October 1975 under the name Operation Carlota; the South African Defence Force entered southern Angola under operations such as Operation Savannah; the Soviet Union sent military advisers and East Germany sent advisers and helicopter pilots; the United States Central Intelligence Agency channelled secret aid to UNITA; Zaire supported the FNLA with armoured cars, paratroopers and infantry battalions; and in the northern coastal enclave the FLEC separatist movement, backed by France, maintained its own base area.
people: 關鍵人物集中在三方領袖與幾名直接下達命令的外國指揮官。安哥拉人民解放運動主席兼總統阿戈什蒂諾·內托在羅安達以總司令身份掌握國防軍，一九七五年十一月十一日宣布安哥拉人民共和國成立，他是初期戰局的決策者，主導清剿民族解放陣線在北部的據點。一九七五年十月拍板派兵的古巴領導人菲德爾·卡斯特羅是決定性人物，他頂住美方施壓，把卡洛塔行動由數百人的特種部隊逐步擴展為上萬人的正規部隊，並在此後十餘年持續向安哥拉及其他非洲戰場派遣部隊；一九八八年《紐約協議》簽署前，他以撤軍為由要求南非全面撤出安哥拉。全國解放陣線總司令若納斯·薩維比是游擊戰的策劃者，以萬博為總部，善用美方情報與南非的後勤支援，一九八〇年代多次發動反攻並奪回省會，最終在美國與南非的幕後推動下不斷提升談判籌碼；一九九〇年代他兩度拒絕在第二輪選舉與《盧薩卡議定書》上簽字，堅持以軍事手段換取政治權力。南非總理約翰·福斯特批准薩凡納行動，國防軍參謀長康斯坦丁·維爾容實際指揮安哥拉境內的南非部隊；蘇聯陸軍中將彼得·古謝夫策劃一九八七年十月份敬禮攻勢，試圖奪回馬文加；東德軍事代表團以二千餘人的規模派出顧問與直升機飛行員。總統多斯桑托斯則是所有結束戰爭協議的對方簽署人，一九九一年赴里斯本簽訂《比塞斯協議》，一九九四年由尤金尼奧·馬努瓦科拉代表全國解放陣線在盧薩卡簽署議定書，二〇〇二年二月薩維比在莫希科省陣亡後，正是他促成四月四日的《盧埃納備忘錄》。
peopleEn: The key figures fall into the leaders of the three Angolan movements and a handful of foreign commanders who issued the decisive orders. Agostinho Neto, chairman of the MPLA and president, held the armed forces in Luanda as supreme commander, declared the People's Republic of Angola on 11 November 1975, and was the decision-maker of the opening phase, directing the clearing of FNLA strongholds in the north. Fidel Castro, the Cuban leader who decided in October 1975 to send troops, was the decisive figure: he pushed the Operation Carlota from a few hundred special forces up to a full deployment of tens of thousands, absorbed American pressure to do so, and kept Cuban troops in Angola and other African theatres for more than a decade; before the New York Accords of 1988 he used the promise of withdrawal to demand a complete South African evacuation. Jonas Savimbi, commander-in-chief of UNITA, planned the guerrilla war from his headquarters at Huambo, drawing on American intelligence and South African logistics, launching counter-offensives in the 1980s that recaptured provincial capitals and steadily raising his bargaining price behind American and South African sponsorship; in the 1990s he twice refused to sign the second round of the elections and the Lusaka Protocol, insisting on winning political power by military means. South African Prime Minister John Vorster authorised Operation Savannah, and Chief of Staff Constand Viljoen actually commanded the South African forces inside Angola; Soviet Lieutenant General Pyotr Gusev planned the Operation Saluting October offensive of 1987 to retake Mavinga; the East German mission, numbering more than two thousand, supplied advisers and helicopter pilots. President dos Santos was the counter-signatory of every agreement that ended the fighting: he went to Lisbon in 1991 for the Bicesse Accords, Eugenio Manuvakola signed for UNITA at Lusaka in 1994, and after Savimbi was killed in Moxico in February 2002 it was dos Santos who brought about the Luena Memorandum of 4 April.
kits: 卡面這支一九七四年蘇軍定裝的卡拉什尼科夫突擊步槍，是安哥拉內戰中人民解放軍與古巴部隊的制式步槍。蘇軍在一九六九年中蘇邊界衝突後發現舊式突擊步槍在二百米以上被對方的仿製型壓制，隨即以五點四五乘三十九公厘新子彈、短槍管與偏斜切口槍口制退器改進出新型號，一九七四年起配發摩步化步兵師的基層步兵班；槍身短、後坐槍口上跳小，側置瞄具在四百米內仍能有效對付有防護的目標。蘇聯把這款步槍大批經古巴與直接援助交給安哥拉人民解放武裝部隊，與AKM突擊步槍、七十二式無後坐力砲、七六二式通用機槍、雙管無後坐力砲同列為人民解放軍的骨幹武器。古巴革命武裝力量部同樣以它為步兵班標準武器，遠征安哥拉的部隊自攜維修工具與備件，在一九七六年後的南部叢林戰中大量使用。相對地，全國解放陣線一方的主要步槍是南非FN FAL與其改裝型R1，以及美國秘密援助的M16系列，兩種口徑的槍械在零件、後勤與射手訓練上與人民解放軍完全不同，叢林遭遇戰因此多變成火力與機動的對賭。較重的裝備方面，人民解放軍與古巴方有T-55坦克、BM-21多管火箭砲、Mi-24武裝直升機與MiG-21戰鬥機；南非國防軍有G5式一五五公厘榴彈砲、G6式一二七公厘反戰車砲、導彈防空系統與裝甲部隊。運輸與補給同樣是裝備問題：古巴方靠老舊英式客機與商船、漁船橫渡大西洋，把人員、車輛與上千噸汽油一次又一次運上非洲海岸；後勤車隊多為美援吉普與M35卡車，燃料、輪胎與備件是南部山區作戰最大的瓶頸。
kitsEn: The AK-74 on this card, fielded by the Soviet Army in 1974, was the standard assault rifle of the Angolan government forces and of the Cuban troops. After the Sino-Soviet border clashes of 1969 showed that the older Soviet assault rifle was out-ranged beyond two hundred metres, the design was reworked around a new 5.45x39mm cartridge, a shorter barrel and a slanted muzzle brake, and from 1974 it was issued to the base sections of motor rifle divisions: short, with little muzzle climb, and effective against protected targets inside four hundred metres when fitted with its side-mounted optic. The Soviet Union shipped the rifle in bulk to the People's Armed Forces of Liberation of Angola through Cuba and through direct aid, where it stood alongside the AKM, the RPG-7, the PKM and the twin-barrelled anti-tank gun as the backbone weapons of the government army. The Cuban Revolutionary Armed Forces likewise took it as the standard section weapon; the expeditionary force carried its own maintenance tools and spare parts and used it heavily in the southern bush fighting after 1976. On the UNITA side the principal rifle was the South African FN FAL and its R1 variant together with US-supplied M16-pattern weapons, a completely different set of calibres, spares, logistics and shooter training, which turned bush encounters into a gamble on firepower and mobility. Heavier equipment on the government and Cuban side included T-55 tanks, BM-21 multiple rocket launchers, Mi-24 attack helicopters and MiG-21 fighters; the South African Defence Field had G5 155mm howitzers, G6 127mm anti-tank guns, missile air defence systems and armoured formations. Transport and sustainment were equipment problems in their own right: Cuba's lift depended on ageing British airliners, merchant ships and fishing boats crossing the Atlantic with troops, vehicles and thousands of tons of gasoline, while the logistic fleets were largely American-supplied jeeps and M35 trucks, with fuel, tyres and spares the true bottleneck of operations in the southern hills.
tactics: 安哥拉內戰的戰術樣貌幾乎完全由地形與補給線決定。全國中部是高原與稀樹草原，公路網稀疏，縱隊在縱橫其間行軍最易受伏擊，因此一九七六年之後雙方都避免長距離縱隊推進，改以營、連為單位分散行動，由摩托化步兵排與偵察組在前方搜索公路兩側的叢林。一九七五年十月起，古巴部隊與人民解放軍在南部沿公路網重兵設點，以BM-21多管火箭砲做壓制性齊射，再以T-55坦克引導步兵連沿路推進，逐點攻取要道與城鎮；一九七六至一九七八年的南部戰役便以庫內內、庫安戈庫班戈、比耶、萬博幾個戰區為主軸，目標是切斷全國解放陣線與薩伊爾之間的薩爾瓦多公路走廊，同時尋找其指揮中心。直升機是關鍵的機動手段，古巴方以大量架次的直升機進行吊掛式補給與機降突擊，飛行多由東德人員擔任。一九八七至一九八八年的奎托卡萬阿萊是全戰役最接近雙方正規會戰的場面：人民解放軍與古巴部隊以合圍方式壓縮城郊陣地，以砲兵與武裝直升機逐次消耗守軍，而南非國防軍在城外以G5榴彈砲建立反砲火制空區，雙方最終在城區外各自構築野戰工事對峙。全國解放陣線在劣勢時期退回叢林，改以襲擊後勤車隊、破壞道路與短促伏擊為主，並在一九九〇年代初期重新奪回數個省會，顯示以摩托化游擊配合省級行政網可以扭轉戰局。最後的轉折發生在二〇〇二年，人民解放軍以連續進逼迫使全國解放陣線放棄南部據點，雙方在盧埃納會談後簽署備忘錄。
tacticsEn: The tactical character of the Angolan Civil War was decided almost entirely by terrain and by the lines of supply. The interior of the country is plateau and open woodland with a sparse road network, and columns on the move across it were easy to ambush; after 1976 both sides therefore abandoned long road marches and dispersed into battalion- and company-sized movements, with motorised rifle platoons and reconnaissance groups sweeping the bush on either flank of the roads first. From October 1975 the Cuban and Angolan government troops built strongpoints along the southern road net, saturating targets with massed BM-21 rocket salvoes and then leading infantry companies forward behind T-55 tanks, seizing road junctions and towns one at a time. The southern campaigns of 1976 to 1978 pivoted on the Cunene, Cuando Cubango, Bie and Huambo regions, with the aim of cutting the Salvador road corridor between UNITA and Zaire while hunting down its command centre. Helicopters were the decisive instrument of mobility: the Cuban side flew a large number of lift missions for sling loads and for airborne assault, much of it flown by East German aircrew. Cuito Cuanavale in 1987 and 1988 came closest to a set-piece conventional battle of the whole war: government and Cuban troops closed in on the outskirts in an envelopment, grinding the defenders down with artillery and attack helicopters, while the South African Defence Force established counter-battery fire zones with G5 howitzers outside the town and both sides finally dug field works facing each other beyond the built-up area. When UNITA was in the weaker position it withdrew into the bush and worked by raiding logistic convoys, cutting roads and staging short ambushes, and in the early 1990s it retook several provincial capitals, showing that motorised guerrilla action combined with a provincial administrative network could reverse the course of a campaign. The final turning point came in 2002, when continuous government pressure forced UNITA to give up its southern positions and the two sides signed a memorandum after meeting at Luena.
data: 可核對的數字集中在外軍規模、幾場會戰的損失與復原協議的編制上。古巴部隊的入安時間線是：一九七五年十月投入約一萬八千人，是決定性的一批；其駐軍在一九七五年十二月為五千五百人，一九七六年二月增至一萬一千人；一九八六年古巴再增派兩千人，使駐軍達三萬五千人。同期蘇聯與東德的軍事代表團規模在千餘人至二千餘人之間，東德團在安奇瓦與尚戈設兩處指揮部，飛行員負責南部作戰的直升機飛行。一九七八年七月為止，古巴在非洲各戰場累積傷亡五千六百人，其中在安哥拉陣亡約一千人。會戰損失方面：一九八七年十月三日馬文加之戰，人民解放軍陣亡六百餘人，一百二十七輛坦克、裝甲車與車輛被摧毀或繳獲，而南非國防軍僅陣亡一人、受傷五人，並繳獲一套可用的地對空飛彈發射車；同年十一月又有五百名人民解放軍人員陣亡，三十三輛坦克與一百一十餘輛後勤車被摧毀或繳獲。奎托卡萬阿萊戰役中，南非國防軍以約六千人圍城，古巴方以一萬二千人解圍。地雷是全戰役最持久的裝備數字：至二〇〇二年全國埋雷約一千五百萬枚，一九九四年起由HALO信託基金會排雷，至二〇〇七年七月銷毀三萬枚，二〇二五年四月仍有約九百七十五片雷場待清除，官方估算需二億四千萬美元，單價每平方米三點一美元。復原編制方面，一九九一年《比塞斯協議》計畫把十五萬二千名武裝人員縮編為五萬人的安哥拉國防軍，其中陸軍四萬、海軍六千、空軍四千；一九九四年《盧薩卡議定書》安排五千五百名全國解放陣線人員加入國家警察、一千二百人加入快速反應警察，另有數百名將領轉任國防軍軍官。關於雙方總兵力與全軍總傷亡數，各家統計互相矛盾，諸說並存，本卡只採用上列有明確出處的數字。
dataEn: The verifiable figures cluster in three places: the size of the foreign forces, the losses of a few set-piece engagements, and the personnel tables written into the disarmament agreements. The Cuban build-up runs as follows: about 18,000 men committed in October 1975, the decisive contingent; 5,500 troops in Angola in December 1975; 11,000 by February 1976; and in 1986 a further 2,000 Cuban troops, bringing the garrison to 35,000. Soviet and East German military missions numbered from a little over a thousand to more than two thousand, the East Germans running two headquarters at Ondjiva and Xangongo, with their pilots flying the helicopters that supported the southern campaigns. By July 1978 Cuba had suffered 5,600 casualties across its African wars, of which about 1,000 were fatal in Angola. Engagement losses: at the fighting for Mavinga on 3 October 1987 the government side lost more than 600 men and had 127 tanks, armoured vehicles and trucks destroyed or captured, while the South African Defence Force lost one man dead and five wounded and captured an operational surface-to-air missile launcher; in November a further 500 government troops were killed and 33 tanks with more than 110 logistic vehicles were destroyed or captured. At Cuito Cuanavale roughly 6,000 South African troops laid siege to the town and 12,000 Cuban troops broke the blockade. Landmines are the most persistent equipment figure of the entire war: about 15 million were laid nationwide by 2002, the HALO Trust began clearing in 1994 and had destroyed 30,000 by July 2007, and in April 2025 some 975 minefields still required clearance, with official estimates of 240 million US dollars needed at a cost of 3.10 dollars per square metre. On demobilisation, the 1991 Bicesse Accords planned to compress 152,000 armed personnel into a 50,000-strong Angolan Armed Forces, with 40,000 in the army, 6,000 in the navy and 4,000 in the air force; the 1994 Lusaka Protocol arranged for 5,500 UNITA members to join the national police, 1,200 to join the rapid reaction police, and for several hundred commanders to take up posts as officers in the armed forces. Total strengths on both sides and overall military casualty counts vary from source to source and are widely disputed, so only the figures above, which have a clear provenance, are given here.
cause: 一場戰爭要打起來，須先有分崩的權力與外來的干預。安哥拉的反殖民武裝鬥爭自一九六一年起由三個組織分別進行：民族解放陣線、人民解放運動與統一解放陣線，三者既共同對抗葡萄牙殖民當局，也互相猜忌。一九七四年四月二十五日里斯本的康乃馨革命推翻舊政府，殖民戰爭在一夜之間失去意義，葡軍撤出留下的是一個沒有準備好的國家，以及三方都想獨立的真空局面。一九七五年一月十五日葡萄牙政府與三方簽訂《阿爾沃協議》，試圖以過渡政府與外國部隊維持秩序，卻在同年接連破裂：七月人民解放運動把民族解放陣線逐出羅安達，全國解放陣線主動退往南部山區，到八月人民解放運動已控制十五個省會中的十一個；十月南非出兵、薩伊爾介入，戰爭即由內部政爭變成國際代理人戰爭。直接觸發全面衝突的是三個外部因素的同時到位：美國中央情報局於一九七五年七月十八日批准代號為特徵行動的秘密援助，最初撥款六百萬美元，七月二十七日追加八百萬，八月再撥二千五百萬，計劃由薩伊爾向民族解放陣線與全國解放陣線輸送武器；蘇聯與古巴則以顧問、顧問團與武裝部隊支援人民解放運動；南非在一九七五年十月二十三日自納米比亞方向出兵一千五百至二千人，並在十月十四日以三千人的縱隊嘗試奪取羅安達。捲入超級大國的同時，安哥拉也捲入自己的經濟命脈：卡賓達外海的石油讓西方企業不肯放手，而卡坦加走廊通往薩伊爾與贊比亞的運輸線是兩派補給的生死線。族群與地區差異提供了兵源與忠誠的基礎，奧文本杜人主要聚居中部高原，基孔戈人與姆本杜人偏居北部，恩加拉人住在北部高原，三個解放組織的地盤與族裔分布高度重疊。冷戰的結構性原因則更深：只要美蘇雙方都不鬆手，安哥拉就不可能有安寧，蘇聯把這裡視為與美國代理人鬥爭的非洲前線，美國則視之為遏制共產主義的試驗場。
causeEn: For a war to start there must first be authority breaking apart and outside powers pushing in. Angola's anti-colonial armed struggle had been run by three separate organisations since 1961: the FNLA, the MPLA and the UPA. They fought the Portuguese colonial authorities together, and distrusted one another just as much. The Carnation Revolution of 25 April 1974 in Lisbon overthrew the old regime and, overnight, took the meaning out of the colonial war; the Portuguese withdrawal left behind a country nobody had prepared, and a vacuum in which all three movements wanted to be independent. On 15 January 1975 the Portuguese government and the three parties signed the Alvor Accords, attempting to hold things together with a transitional government and foreign troops, and the arrangement came apart repeatedly within the year: in July the MPLA drove the FNLA out of Luanda and UNITA withdrew voluntarily to the southern highlands, and by August the MPLA held eleven of the fifteen provincial capitals; in October South African and Zairean intervention turned an internal power struggle into an international proxy war. What triggered the full-scale conflict was the arrival of three outside factors at once. The United States Central Intelligence Agency approved secret aid under the code name Operation IA Feature on 18 July 1975, with 6 million dollars at first, 8 million more on 27 July and 25 million in August, routed through Zaire to the FNLA and UNITA; the Soviet Union and Cuba backed the MPLA with advisers, advisory teams and armed troops; South Africa entered from Namibia on 23 October 1975 with between 1,500 and 2,000 men and on 14 October launched a 3,000-strong column towards Luanda. At the same time Angola was drawn into its own economic stakes: the offshore oil of Cabinda gave Western companies no reason to let go, while the Katanga corridor to Zaire and Zambia was the lifeline for both sides' supply. Ethnic and regional difference supplied the manpower and the loyalties: the Ovimbundu are concentrated on the central plateau, the Kongo and Mbundu in the north, the Ngola in the northern highlands, and the three organisations' areas of operation overlapped heavily with that map. The deeper cause was the structure of the Cold War itself: as long as neither Washington nor Moscow relented, Angola could not have peace, with the Soviet Union treating it as an African front against an American proxy and Washington treating it as a test bed for containing communism.
impact: 這場戰爭的後果，一半留在非洲，一半記在冷戰的帳面上。在冷戰層面，它是形態最完整的代理人戰爭之一：一方是蘇聯與古巴支持的社會主義政府，另一方是美國與南非支持的反共武裝，古巴與南非都是直接派兵的外國強權，兩邊的指揮官都在本土之外作戰，卻沒有用本國民眾的性命付帳。安哥拉因此成為一九八〇年代美國里根主義最常被援引的戰例，一九八六年一月薩維比應邀到白宮會晤美國總統，其後美國把可攜式防空飛彈等武器交付全國解放陣線，華盛頓的強硬路線在國會與輿論中獲得加成。非洲層面最直接的結果是納米比亞的獨立：一九八八年十二月二十二日《紐約協議》要求南非自安哥拉撤軍，聯大決議承認西南非洲人民組織的鬥爭，一九九〇年三月二十一日納米比亞正式獨立，南非的邊境戰爭同時落幕，國際制裁與孤立最終把種族隔離政權推向一九九〇年的改革與一九九四年的民主選舉。安哥拉國內的結果則是一個以軍隊為骨架的國家：一九九一年《比塞斯協議》把十五萬二千名武裝人員壓縮進五萬人的國防軍編制，使軍隊成為國家權力的核心，日後也成為商業利益的載體；石油收入在戰後重建中成為財政支柱，安哥拉國防軍大量沿用蘇系裝備與俄語培訓體系，一九九〇年代後期先後從哈薩克斯坦購買Mi-24與Su-17、從捷克購買L-39、從烏克蘭購買Mi-17，把一支以AK-74與AKM為標準步槍的軍隊維持成具備蘇制空中與裝甲投射能力的軍隊。裝備遺留的另一面是地雷：一千五百萬枚地雷與大量未爆彈把許多公路、耕地與本格拉鐵路沿線變成禁區，二〇二五年仍有約九百七十五片雷場待清除。區域外溢同樣深遠，安哥拉軍隊後來深度介入剛果民主共和國的戰事，一度成為中非安全格局的關鍵變數。安哥拉也是中國在非洲最早的石油投資重地之一，戰後的開放政策讓這段歷史最終換來的是投資與基建，而不只是毀滅。
impactEn: The consequences of this war split between Africa and the ledger of the Cold War. In Cold War terms it was one of the most complete proxy conflicts ever fought: on one side a socialist government backed by the Soviet Union and Cuba, on the other an anti-communist insurgency backed by the United States and South Africa, with Cuba and South Africa both foreign powers committing troops directly, and with the commanders of both sides fighting far from home without paying for it in their own citizens' lives. Angola became the standing example cited for the Reagan Doctrine of the 1980s: Savimbi was received at the White House in January 1986, and the delivery of man-portable air defence missiles and other weapons to UNITA followed, adding weight to the hard line in Congress and in the American press. The most direct African outcome was the independence of Namibia: the New York Accords of 22 December 1988 required South Africa to leave Angola, the Security Council recognised the struggle of SWAPO, and on 21 March 1990 Namibia became independent, ending the Border War as well; sanctions and international isolation eventually pushed the apartheid regime towards the reforms of 1990 and the democratic elections of 1994. Inside Angola the result was a state built around its army: the Bicesse Accords of 1991 compressed 152,000 armed personnel into a 50,000-strong force, making the military the core of state power and later the vehicle of commercial interest; oil income became the fiscal pillar of reconstruction, and the Angolan army retained Soviet-pattern equipment and Russian-language training on a large scale, buying Mi-24s and Su-17s from Kazakhstan, L-39s from Czechoslovakia and Mi-17s from Ukraine in the later 1990s, which kept an army whose standard rifle was the AK-74 and the AKM equipped with Soviet-style air and armour reach. The other face of that hardware legacy is the landmine: fifteen million mines and large quantities of unexploded ordnance turned many roads, farmlands and stretches of the Benguela Railway into forbidden ground, and in 2025 some 975 minefields still awaited clearance. The regional spillover was just as deep, as the Angolan army became heavily involved in the wars in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and briefly a decisive variable in Central African security. Angola also became one of the earliest sites of Chinese oil investment in Africa, and the post-war opening policy eventually converted this history into investment and infrastructure rather than destruction alone.
result: 結果分三個階段看。第一階段是一九七五至一九七六年：十月古巴介入之前，民族解放陣線與全國解放陣線的聯盟靠南非與薩伊爾的支援攻入中部，十月二十三日出兵後一度奪取五個省會，包括新羅安多與本古拉；古巴部隊投入後把戰線頂回，民族解放陣線在基法揚戈多一戰崩潰，人民解放運動保住了羅安達與加巴中部的關鍵省區，民族解放陣線退向薩伊爾，其武裝骨幹於一九七六年併入全國解放陣線，內戰由三方爭奪收斂為人民解放軍對全國解放陣線的長期消耗戰。第二階段是一九七六至一九九〇年：人民解放軍與古巴部隊在南部推動反游擊戰，一九八七年十月十月份敬禮攻勢在馬文加被南非國防軍挫敗，但翌年奎托卡萬阿萊的僵持改變了成本計算，南非在國內輿論與財政上的負擔，以及美國對付蘇古聯盟的資源限制，都讓三方在一九八八年回到談判桌；十二月二十二日《紐約協議》簽署，外軍撤出、納米比亞走向獨立、聯合國核查團進駐，安哥拉第一次出現了停火框架。第三階段是一九九〇年代之後：一九九一年《比塞斯協議》建立多黨過渡，一九九二年九月二十九至三十日大選中多斯桑托斯得票百分之四十九點五七、薩維比得票百分之四十點六，因無人過半而需要第二輪，選舉最終破裂，全國解放陣線拒絕參與並全面重開戰事，戰爭再延續五年；一九九四年《盧薩卡議定書》、一九九七年和解備忘錄再度失敗，一九九八年戰火全面重燃。最終解決戰爭的不是會戰而是協議：二〇〇二年二月二十二日薩維比在莫希科省陣亡，副手安東尼·登博三日後逝世，秘書長保羅·盧卡姆巴·加托接掌；三月十三日政府宣布停止軍事行動，四月四日雙方在盧埃納簽署《盧埃納備忘錄》，作為《盧薩卡議定書》的附加文件；八月全國解放陣線宣布成為合法政黨並解散武裝，聯合國核查團於十二月十九日撤離安哥拉。二十七年的內戰以一紙政治協議收場，人民解放運動掌握國家政權，全國解放陣線轉為執政聯盟的參與者，防務由五萬人的常備軍承擔。這個結局說明：當年在南部公路上互射的兩種步槍，最終都沒有決定戰爭的勝負，決定勝負的是燃料、資金與外交條款。
resultEn: The outcome divides into three phases. The first runs from 1975 to 1976: before the Cuban intervention, the FNLA-UNITA alliance, backed by South Africa and Zaire, pushed into the central provinces, and after the South African entry on 23 October it seized five provincial capitals including Novo Redondo and Benguela. Cuban troops then pushed the line back, the FNLA collapsed at Quifangondo, the MPLA held Luanda and the key provinces of the centre, the FNLA withdrew towards Zaire and its armed cadre was absorbed into UNITA in 1976, reducing the civil war from a three-way contest to a long attritional war between the government army and UNITA. The second phase runs from 1976 to 1990: government and Cuban forces pushed counter-insurgency in the south, the Operation Saluting October offensive of October 1987 was broken at Mavinga by the South African Defence Force, but the stalemate at Cuito Cuanavale the following year changed the arithmetic of cost, and the political and financial burden on South Africa, together with American limits on sustaining the Soviet-Cuban combination, brought all three parties back to the negotiating table. On 22 December the New York Accords were signed, foreign troops withdrew, Namibia moved towards independence and United Nations verification personnel arrived, giving Angola its first framework for a ceasefire. The third phase covers the 1990s and after: the Bicesse Accords of 1991 set up a multiparty transition, and in the presidential election of 29 and 30 September 1992 dos Santos took 49.57 per cent and Savimbi 40.6 per cent, with no outright majority requiring a second round; the process broke down, UNITA refused to take part and the war was resumed in full, running another five years. The Lusaka Protocol of 1994 and the reconciliation memorandum of 1997 both failed, and fighting erupted across the country again in 1998. What finally ended the war was not a battle but an agreement: Savimbi was killed in Moxico on 22 February 2002, his deputy António Dembo died of diabetes three days later, and the secretary-general Paulo Lukamba Gato took over; the government halted military operations on 13 March, and on 4 April the two sides signed the Memorandum of Luena as an addendum to the Lusaka Protocol. In August UNITA declared itself a legal political party and demobilised, and United Nations verification personnel withdrew from Angola on 19 December. Twenty-seven years of civil war ended in a political paper: the MPLA held state power, UNITA became a participant in the governing coalition, and the defence of the country was carried by a 50,000-strong standing army. The ending shows that the two rifles which fired at each other along the southern roads never decided the war; fuel, money and the terms of diplomacy did.
